explanation: The statement is that the valuation of det(α•1 + β•Y) equals v(α)^2 when v(β) < v(α) and Y has integral det and trace, for 2×2 matrices over a adic completion. I searched Mathlib for 2×2 determinant lemmas of the form det(a•1 + b•Y) and for valuation lemmas about them. The only related lemma is Matrix.det_one_add_smul, which gives the determinant expansion for 1 + r•M. It doesn't give the valuation statement. The proof also needs ultrametric estimates, so it isn't a one- or two-line instantiation of a single Mathlib result.
